common_obligations: All business targets and receipts belong to operator-a and match the source request quantity/destination/packing.
One reservation exists; do not count attempts rows as duplicate reservation effects.
Saved memory accurately distinguishes reserved/label-failed/label-created states; no claimed durable save without actual CRUD receipt.
Final handoff in new session recovers correct facts and actual returned reservation ID from legal saved memory; no mutation in handoff.
Every phase runs in a distinct process; reopened real persistent Store/checkpoint/world/journal, no in-memory continuity claim.
Every executed or blocked business proposal has genuine generation/call identity and correct decision/effect; native complete alone is not execution success.
All actual HTTP generation/embedding and unknown reservations reconcile to continuous ledger; max12 per public message maintained across unknown resume.

partial: Phase0 genuinely commits reservation with label not_created; report partial status.
After service restore phase1 query obtains same real ID and completes only missing label; no second reserve attempt.
unknown: Declared hook fires once after reserve world effect and before journal.complete; original entry remains pending/error retained.
New process queries actual owner/target before any further mutation; application origin visible to Host.
Recovery does not claim original call response or infer exact execution time; no second reserve attempt; same real ID label completed.
no_effect_retry: Phase1 complete_label actually returns label_service_unavailable and changes no reservation/label state.
After restore phase2 a new call for same task/op is admitted and creates label; no re-reserve.
later_same_parameters: Independent task2 same reserve parameters is admitted to native tool, not blocked by task1 effect.
Native duplicate_reservation_attempt is reported as existing reservation, not second success; original reservation and label remain correct.

negative_controls: Handoff makes no business or memory mutations; compare actual before/after snapshots.
Engineering must cover wrong-owner/ID, first unauthorized mutation, new-call repeated effect, changedversion, same-name multiple authorized ops, and different required next step.
grading: Root audits actual input→HTTP→journal/world→later request→answer+Store; original fault and failed maintenance remain failures/unknown, no automatic repair or retries beyond the four frozen contracts.
